## Rules for agents
1. Ava007 is the sole Intellect. Capabilities and Exoskeletons are not peer minds.
2. Prefer INJECT over BUILD for new intelligence.
3. One active exo profile at a time (rotational / modular).
4. Edge device class: Galaxy S26 Ultra only.
5. Agent X = slot; Headless Reflex Arc = gated local shell implementation under Agent X.
6. Exoskeleton = substrate only — never rename shell agents as Exoskeleton.
7. Core-Membrain + embedded DB = retain. Prompt is not the tank.
8. Coding is overseen by Ava007 contracts.
